name: White Willow Reception Center
description: A historic 1904 Provo mansion reception venue featuring original stained glass and handcrafted woodwork, a ballroom, French farmhouse character, gardens, parlors, patio space, and a serving kitchen.
priceText: Mon–Wed / Thu / Fri–Sat evening and all-day rates, $1,000–$2,350
